Women's Tuesday Group Ride

Broomfield, CO · Road · Mixed

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendlyNo-drop

Women's Tuesday Group Ride is a road group ride in Broomfield, CO. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Trek Bicycle Broomfield. About 15–25 miles, no-drop, 13–15 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women's Tuesday Group Ride group ride

A women's shop ride on roads, paths and the occasional smooth gravel stretch. Around 13–15 mph, 15–25 miles, and no one gets dropped. Posted weekly on the shop's Meetup.
